title: Mike Evans remains sidelined at training camp as injury woes mount on offense for 49ers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mike Evans remains sidelined at training camp as injury woes mount on offense for 49ers
sources.description: Ricky Pearsall's out for the season. George Kittle's recovering from an Achilles tear. Christian Kirk, De'Zhaun Stribling and Kyle Juszczyk are all sidelined from practice.
